hotel.name: The St. Regis Resort Bora Bora

verified_facts.text: The resort is located on a motu (islet), so boat transfers are needed to and from Bora Bora's airport and the main island.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Bora Bora Resort is located on a motu (islet) and boat transfers will be necessary from/to Bora Bora Domestic Airport or to reach Bora Bora main island (Vaitape).

verified_facts.text: The boat transfer from Bora Bora's airport to the resort takes 20 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The transfer itself is a 20-minute boat ride.

verified_facts.text: The resort's overwater villas are the largest in French Polynesia and the South Pacific, starting at 1,550 square feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in the largest overwater villas in French Polynesia and the South Pacific, starting at 1,550 square feet

verified_facts.text: The overwater villas have glass viewing panels cut into the floor to show tropical fish swimming by.
verified_facts.excerpt: glass viewing panels throughout, cut into the floor to provide glimpses of tropical fish swimming by

verified_facts.text: Every overwater villa has a separate living room and bedroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every overwater villa is comprised of a separate living room and bedroom

verified_facts.text: The Royal Estate is a private compound enclosed on three sides by coral walls that opens onto its own private beach facing the lagoon and Mount Otemanu.
verified_facts.excerpt: the private compound is enclosed on three sides by coral walls and opens up to its own private beach facing a sparkling lagoon and Mount Otemanu

verified_facts.text: The resort's private Lagoonarium is a protected underwater sanctuary for tropical fish and coral, including Napoleon fish.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Bora Bora hotel's private Lagoonarium is a protected underwater sanctuary for myriad species of tropical fish and coral, including the remarkable Napoleon fish.

verified_facts.text: Snorkeling gear for the Lagoonarium is complimentary.
verified_facts.excerpt: with complimentary snorkeling gear provided

verified_facts.text: The spa is located on its own private island overlooking the Lagoonarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax and rejuvenate at the spa, located on its own private island overlooking the serene Lagoonarium.

verified_facts.text: All spa bookings require a day pass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that all spa bookings require a day pass.

verified_facts.text: Lagoon Restaurant is suspended over the water, has views of Mount Otemanu and showcases local produce and freshly caught seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: This suspended water restaurant in Bora Bora offers views of Mount Otemanu and showcases local produce and freshly caught seafood.

verified_facts.text: Lagoon Restaurant has glass panels revealing the lagoon below.
verified_facts.excerpt: set overwater with glass panels revealing the turquoise lagoon below

verified_facts.text: Te Pahu hosts a Polynesian show and dinner every Wednesday night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us for Polynesian Show & Dinner at Te Pahu every Wednesday night

verified_facts.text: Breakfast can be delivered to your villa on a va'a, a traditional Polynesian canoe.
verified_facts.excerpt: breakfast delivered on a va’a, the traditional Polynesian pirogue, to your private villa

verified_facts.text: The 727 Bar serves tapas on a terrace looking out at the sunset over Mount Otemanu.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy refined tapas on the terrace while admiring the spectacular sunset over Mount Otemanu at this beach bar in Bora Bora

verified_facts.text: Farniente Ristorante serves Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor the flavors of Italy during your stay at Farniente Ristorante.

verified_facts.text: Bamboo Restaurant serves Asian flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pay a visit to Bamboo Restaurant and discover the bold yet delicate flavors of Asia.

verified_facts.text: A full in-room dining menu is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: a full in-room dining menu is available 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: Complimentary watersports at the Main Beach include stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking and local canoe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy complimentary watersports at the Main Beach, including stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking and local canoe.

verified_facts.text: A Cultural Ambassador leads activities such as flower crown making and pareo painting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in this rich heritage through activities led by our Cultural Ambassador, such as flower crown making, pareo painting, and more.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a once-a-day complimentary shuttle to the main island and Vaitape, except on Sundays and public holidays.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Resort extends a once-a-day complimentary shuttle service to the main island and the village of Vaitape, except on Sundays and public holidays.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the 17-hectare resort by bicycle.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore the 17-hectare resort by bicycle

verified_facts.text: For children the resort provides child-sized robes, slippers and a step stool.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers delectable treats, child-sized robes, slippers, and a step stool for the little ones

verified_facts.text: The resort first opened in 2006.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property first opened on one of Bora Bora’s most beautiful motus in 2006

verified_facts.text: The resort was designed by Parisian architect Pierre Lacombe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Parisian architect Pierre Lacombe, the resort made the pages of Architectural Digest when it debuted.

verified_facts.text: The spa's island is reached by wooden bridges from the main motu and is surrounded by the Lagoonarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: accessed by wooden bridges from the main motu and surrounded by the Lagoonarium

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a coral cutting workshop at the Lagoonarium led by the resort's marine biologists.
verified_facts.excerpt: participating in a coral cutting workshop at the Lagoonarium led by the resort’s marine biologists

verified_facts.text: Every villa comes with a pair of beach cruiser-style bicycles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every villa comes with a pair of beach cruiser-style bicycles with baskets for exploring the sprawling grounds.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18
